name: troubleshoot-binding-failure
prompt: A WPF TextBox binding silently fails after a DataContext change. Diagnose the issue before proposing a rewrite and provide concrete validation steps.
rubric: Inspects binding diagnostics, DataContext, property path, converter, update trigger, and notifications.
Makes the smallest coherent correction instead of replacing the view model by default.
Includes an observable regression test or repeatable manual verification.
